text:
Maya (DevRel): quick idea — run a 3-day "Snacklet Studio" mini-lab: 3 tiny tutorials + one short benchmark post + a 30-min hands-on webinar. goal: low friction demos for new users, high-quality inbound. who wants which piece?
Sanjay (Growth): love it. what are the core KPIs we should aim for? signups, github stars, demo completions? also distribution cadence?
Ellie (Content): think: Day 1 tutorial (getting started + streaming), Day 2 deeper sample (embeddings + rerank), Day 3 mini-benchmark + guide to Optimize tips. can do copy for launch post + email. need repo + one reference app.
Ryan (Product Marketing): benchmark narrative: highlight latency/cost improvements with Optimize presets, and a simple A/B showing caching vs no-caching. want a small table of numbers (p95 latency, avg token cost) and a short blurb.
Kate (Design): I can do thumbnails and slide deck template. timeline: need final art 48h before webinar. mockups by EOD tomorrow?
deploy-bot: uploaded: drive.redwood.ai/snacklet-studio/assets (contains slide template + starter repo link) :white_check_mark:
Maya (DevRel): @Ellie @Ryan i sketched a funnel: blog -> short tutorial -> signup for workshop -> small repo star -> follow-up eval email with bench results. routing: tag inbound leads from "snacklet-studio" and route high-engagement to SE trial team.
Sanjay (Growth): for routing, propose segments: "clicked tutorial" (nurture), "attended webinar" (qualified), "forked repo" (dev engagement). UTMs for tracking. sample UTM: `?utm_source=snacklet-studio&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=mini-labs`
Ellie (Content): rough copy for social + email (drop feedback):
- Social: "New: Snacklet Studio — 3 tiny tutorials to ship LLM features with Redwood in < 30 mins. RSVP for the hands-on lab."
- Email subject: "Build an LLM mini-feature in 30 minutes — Snacklet Studio"
Ryan (Product Marketing): keep the benchmark narrative tight: one hero stat + one technical callout. e.g., "40% lower per-token cost with prefix caching + batch policy X" + short reproducible command snippet for the bench.
Maya (DevRel): speaking of reproducibility, @Ryan can you draft the bench command we want users to run? include model, sequence length, batch size.
Ryan (Product Marketing): draft command: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-llm-small --seq 512 --batch 8 --cache on` (will publish results and raw logs in repo).
Kate (Design): quick note: thumbnails should be square + 16:9 hero for blog. i'll attach two color options in drive.
Ellie (Content): timeline proposal:
- Today: finalize topics + assign owners
- +3 days: publish blog + tutorial #1 + social drip
- +7 days: tutorial #2 + webinar RSVP opens
- +10 days: webinar + publish benchmark post + follow-up nurture
Can we compress?
Sanjay (Growth): compressed schedule ok if we reduce scope: swap deep bench to a short appendix. main funnel matters. i'll coordinate email segments and set up lead routing rules with SEops.
Maya (DevRel): owners: Ellie = copy + tutorial drafts, Ryan = bench and numbers, Kate = design, Sanjay = distribution + routing, me = webinar ops + repo maintainer. agree?
All: :+1:
Ellie (Content): posting checklist I'll use: repo link, quickstart README, 3 gifs for tutorial steps, bench logs, email copy, CTAs (star repo, signup for trial). will drop PR by tomorrow morning.
Maya (DevRel): quick CTA copy for workshop registration: "Join Snacklet Studio: a 30-min hands-on lab to build, benchmark, and ship a mini LLM feature." short form fields: name, company, email, role, interest area.
Sanjay (Growth): I'll wire up the form and segmentation. routing rules: webinar attendees -> tag:snacklet_attended; repo forks -> tag:snacklet_forked; email opens + click -> nurture stage.
Maya (DevRel): small ops note: please add `source=snacklet-studio` to internal tracking and include the tag in the webhook payload to SEops.
deploy-bot: created PR: github.com/redwood-inference/snacklet-studio/pull/12 — includes tutorial-1 draft and assets.
Ryan (Product Marketing): next: i'll draft the short benchmark narrative and a 2-slide "how we measured" for the webinar. will push by EOD.
Kate (Design): i'll upload thumbnails + slide theme v1 in drive.
Ellie (Content): I'll queue the blog draft and social calendar. need approval on hero stat from @Ryan before scheduling.
Maya (DevRel): wrap-up: looks good. action items: everyone add ETA to the PR and flag blockers by EOD. tagging ops: @deploy-bot please remind 24h before publication.
Sanjay (Growth): noted. i'll set calendar invites for review sessions.
Maya (DevRel): thanks team. excited to ship this — low-effort, dev-first content that should drive strong signal and early trial flows. :rocket:
